title: chg(podman/system): add `--format` support to `hyperv-prep --status`
body:
Add `--format` support (JSON and Go templates) to `podman system hyperv-prep --status`.

- Outputs booleans`currentUserIsHyperVAdmin`, `hasRequiredRegistryEntries`, and an Enum `status` (`applied`, `notApplied`, `partiallyApplied`)
- Reject `--format` when used without `--status` to prevent unintended side-effects.

Fixes #29860

Tests are LLM-generated and human reviewed. Please let me know if you find them to be too verbose, I can clean them up (Tho I do think they are just extensive and cover many combinations / cases).

comments.body:
@gastoner I've added the `status` field as per the issue (other keys are slightly modified to better represent the context). Tho I'm not really sure if the `status` field provides any extra value as all the required info is present in the other fields.

Also I'm not sure if the existing behavior for `status` should be modified (it doesn't show any warnings for missing registry entries and doesn't consider membership changes that haven't taken effect - user added to group but needs to relogin for it to work). Any thoughts on this?
